name: babili-instagram-agent
description: Fourteen Claude skills that run an Instagram account in six languages: English, Arabic (Iraqi, Gulf, Levantine, Egyptian), Russian, Turkish, Polish and Czech. Scored hooks and beat sheets for Reels, niche research, caption linting, carousels, stories, profile score, weekly plan, comments, replies, DMs, audits and a humanizer. Multilingual fork of Jakeschincariol/instagram-agent-skill.
